answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. One intervention must keep taking customer writes, so fail away from the only sick region rather than bet the window on a single cause. memory_b2 is the closest precedent (regional latency degradation, clean shift, recovery in minutes). Cause is still uncertain: the release is coincident, not proven. Rollback (memory_b1) only helps if the build is at fault and would miss a primary-only infra or capacity fault. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails fast and would drop settlement writes. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) is for reporting reads, not this write path. Pre-peak headroom (memory_b3) is not a mid-incident 5x fix. Broad failover is the one shot that can restore availability; flag downstream settlement-consistency/overload risk on the secondary.
